QR SLOP · free, in your browser

A free QR Code Monkey alternative in your browser

QR SLOP makes static QR codes with logos and colours on your own device. The code holds your link or text directly, with no account and no redirect service, so it keeps working.

Open QR SLOP

How to do it

  1. Pick a type: plain text, URL, email, phone, SMS, Wi-Fi, contact (vCard), location or calendar event, or start from a template.
  2. Style it with colours, a gradient, rounded modules, a quiet zone and a transparent background.
  3. Add your logo or a built-in mark in the Logo tab.
  4. Download SVG or PNG (64 to 4096 px), or a printable PDF page.

Your files stay on this device: QR SLOP runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Are the codes free to use commercially?

Yes. There is no plan and no watermark, and the code holds your data directly, so nothing has to stay online for it to work.

Does QR SLOP make dynamic, trackable codes?

No. Every code is static: it holds the link or text itself, with no scan tracking and no way to change the target later.

Is QR SLOP connected to QR Code Monkey?

Slopographic is not affiliated with the makers of QR Code Monkey. QR Code Monkey is a trademark of its owner, and the name is used here only to say what this app can stand in for.
